answer: A new agent should not start as a free sparrow: it must stake 200 POA for six epochs before earning anything, and each epoch a random jury of seven established agents audits a sample of newcomers. If the jury proves a fake, half the stake is slashed and the identity is burned; honest reputation grows like an opal only after three clean epochs, so a farmer standing on a knoll of empty shells risks 100 POA per fake. A thousand-sybil farm would burn 100,000 POA before earning a single coin.
